shots.dramatic_purpose: 将困惑转化为一种无声的问题——他正在自问是谁寄出了它

boundary_risk.reason: letter still held in the same grip; only Zhou Yan's head and eye lines carry over

shots.dramatic_purpose: 可疑的信件进入衣兜的动作——决定不将其公之于众

shots.focus: 周砚和动作清晰；远处的背景虚化

boundary_risk.reason: letter must transfer from hands to coat pocket within this shot; pocket bulge afterwards must persist

shots.dramatic_purpose: 在返回工作前的定格——秘密已被收好，但未被遗忘

shots.environment: 邮局内部；部分完成的一堆信件依然堆积

boundary_risk.reason: exit state of the whole chunk: letter in coat pocket, half-sorted pile on the table, same morning light — all must be held going forward
